findings.title: Fallback translation files are only preloaded for controller requests
findings.body: The fallback locales are explicitly loaded only from this ApplicationController filter. The lazy-loading patch still loads only `I18n.config.locale` when `I18n.t` is called, while `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` invokes the backend directly for each fallback locale. Consequently, mailers, background jobs, console tasks, or any `I18n.with_locale` usage outside a controller can try a fallback whose YAML file was never loaded and return a missing-translation result instead of the site/default-English fallback. Load all `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` as part of the translation/lazy-loading path rather than relying on this request filter.

findings.title: Cached translations do not vary with the configured fallback locale
findings.body: The translation cache key contains only the requested key, current locale, and backend object id, but a missing translation now also depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale` through `FallbackLocaleList`. If an admin changes the site default locale, entries previously resolved through the old fallback remain cached for users of another locale and continue returning the old language until eviction or an `I18n.reload!`. Include fallback configuration in the cache key or clear/reload this cache when `default_locale` changes.
